g.text: What a DPU offloads: infrastructure software moves off the host CPU onto the BlueField
B · With a BlueField DPU (or SuperNIC + DPU)

text.tspan: Provider's control plane runs on a host the tenant can reach:
weak isolation for bare-metal GPU clouds

g.text: BlueField DPU = NIC + Arm cores + accelerators (DOCA software)

text.tspan: Provider's software runs on the DPU, out of the tenant's reach;
GPUs receive data directly (GPUDirect RDMA / Storage)
Tenant / AI work gets ~100% of cores
(tenant may own the whole OS: bare metal)
